## Before you open this PR

SOFA is developed and maintained **in-house by Embedded Systems Academy
(EmSA)**. As described in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md), we
**generally do not merge external pull requests** — the codebase is kept
consistent with our internal coding standard and roadmap.

This PR may be closed with a pointer to the email channel below. The idea
behind it may still be considered for an in-house change, so your input is
not wasted — but please **do not invest significant effort expecting a
merge**.

The best way to propose a change is to email us first:

- **opensource@em-sa.com**
- Security issues: see [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) — do **not** report
  these in public.

By submitting a contribution you confirm you have the right to license it
under the project's [Apache License 2.0](../LICENSE) (inbound = outbound).
